author: Clijmart
body:
Hey Avicus Players.

We decided to make another map today. (Clijmart & Acytlon)
Here are some screenshots with information for you to look at and base your opinion on.
Map download: COMING SOON


You get these items when you join the game.
http://imgur.com/lSZk7hc

The middle islands look like this, the name from the map comes from the yin yang shape. (duhh)
http://imgur.com/lSZk7hc

This is the white spawn island, the place you start your adventure.
http://imgur.com/dvdOV4M

Your mission lays here, try to break the obsidian to make the beacon shine.
http://imgur.com/Jbnq34Y

The first view you get when the game has started.
http://imgur.com/9ArnulS

An sideview of the map.
http://imgur.com/Ah72USv

An overview of the map.
http://imgur.com/kpNMkYR

Thanks for reading and make sure you give us some feedback down below :)

Here is the YML and Download link for the YinYang map :P

YML: http://pastebin.com/1BUk1Rs2
Download: https://www.mediafire.com/#fixddgqhvbc9v

Thanks a lot guys!

replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
This map looks awesome on the server, and I'd like to commend you on your work.
The map is not without it's flaws, however.
As DafrozenBlaze has stated, the map could stalemate often seeing as there are
a lot of islands, as well as not enough form of coverage or structure to the map.
In all, it's rather flat and could use some structures, similar to spawn and mid. 

Just to summarize, I'd suggest adding more structures such as blockades, and removing some islands
to make the map more well-rounded and decreasing the risk of stalemating.

Overall a very good looking and creative map, great work! :)

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Congratulations!

Your Map, Yin Yang, has been accepted for testing!



Here are some Map Developer Comments:

"Remove some unnecessary islands but overall, +1" - Edans

"Good quality map, definite yes" - timaeusTestified

"I want to see it tested" - GrapeSmoothie


Please add me on Skype (Sethskye) if you have Skype so we can go on further details on Testing or on how to improve this map more or you can find me on The Avicus TeamSpeak.
